messages:
maria.g: quick ping — PR #4321 adds a small tokenizer compatibility shim for nova3b. can someone take a look? https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4321 :eyes:

maria.g: main change is a tiny config switch + fallback mapping. i rebased onto main and one unit test is failing in CI, not sure why. snippet below:
```yaml
tokenizer:
  trim_null: true
  byte_fallback: true
  vocab_patch: {}
```

kai: I can take this in ~2h, pinging in case someone else is faster. :+1:

ci-bot: CI report for PR #4321 — run: ubuntu-20.04 / py3.9
failed: tokenization/compat_test.py::test_byte_fallback
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File \"tests/tokenization/compat_test.py\", line 42, in test_byte_fallback
    decoded = tokenizer.decode(bytes([0, 195, 40]))
UnicodeDecodeError: 'utf-8' codec can't decode byte 195 in position 1: invalid start byte

oliver: hmm, looks like legacy vocab doesn't handle raw 0xC3 bytes. try adding a mapping so the tokenizer treats unknown bytes as <unk> or uses a byte fallback table. jules added something similar for atlas onboarding.

jules: quick note — we had the same failure on atlas-2k. the fix was to set vocab_patch: { \"\u0000\": \"<null>\" } and enable byte_fallback. i can push a tiny follow-up commit if you want, @maria.g.

maria.g: @jules that'd be great, thanks. i'll also add a unit to cover the C3 case.

jules: pushed a commit: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/commit/7a1e9b2 — adds vocab_patch + test tweak. /retest?

maria.g: @ci-bot could you re-run the suite for this PR?

ci-bot: Retrigger received. Re-running CI...

ci-bot: CI passed — all checks green. artifacts: https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/artifacts/4321/build

kai: skimmed the changes — LGTM besides a tiny nit on the config comment (typo: \"fallbacks\" -> \"fallback\"). left an inline comment. Approving. :white_check_mark:

oliver: looks good to me too. one question for rollouts: are we ok merging this into main now or do we want to wait for the next config freeze window?

maria.g: I'd prefer to merge after today's quiet period (merge window is 09:30 UTC tomorrow). will squash commits and merge then. i'll add a canary flag in the rollout config in case anything odd surfaces.

kai: sounds good. i'll leave an approval in the PR and will monitor logs during the canary. :mag:

maria.g: thanks all — will merge tomorrow morning and post a heads-up to #eng-oncall if any anomalies. :handshake:

jules: nice, thanks for the fast turnaround everyone.

ci-bot: Notifying reviewers: @kai, @oliver — approvals recorded.
